CEO Wes Cummins reports that these potential new deals, if landed, would significantly expand the company's capacity pipeline to potentially 4 gigawatts, generating an estimated $100 billion in lifetime value. Cummins emphasizes that Applied Digital's contracts are structured to protect the company from an "AI bubble" by ensuring customers are liable for full lease payments even if they cancel.

title: Observability in AI: How Dynatrace adapts to agents
summary: Dynatrace, a company known for providing observability and security for traditional workloads, is now adapting its mission to include support for AI-powered observability. This shift is driven by the rapid adoption of AI models, particularly agentic AI, which introduces new complexities in observability that Dynatrace aims to address by focusing on tracking against goals rather than traditional monitoring. Alois Reitbauer, Dynatrace's chief technology strategist, emphasized the company's focus on bringing observability to agentic operations as AI applications become more dynamic and task-oriented.

title: Canary XRP ETF nets record trading volume of all ETFs launched this year

This success highlights significant demand from both retail and institutional investors for digital asset access, surpassing the previous record set by the Bitwise Solana Staking ETF. summary: Virgin Galactic (SPCE) reported a narrowed Q3 2025 loss of $64 million, down from $75 million in Q3 2024, despite minimal revenue of $0.4 million. title: Nvidia Faces Growing Pressure As Amazon, Microsoft Support Curbs On AI Chip Exports To China: Report (UPDATED)
summary: Amazon and Microsoft are reportedly supporting new U.S. legislation, the Gain AI Act, which aims to further restrict Nvidia's AI chip exports to China. This move creates a rare public split with Nvidia, which is aggressively lobbying against the bill, arguing it would interfere with the semiconductor market and invite additional restrictions, impacting its already shrinking China business. The legislation is being considered for attachment to the annual National Defense Authorization Act amidst broader concerns about tech stock performance and AI-related energy shortages.

summary: Microsoft (MSFT) is significantly expanding its data center footprint with an "AI super factory" in Atlanta, as reported by the Wall Street Journal.
